name: Expanded Inventory
author: OMRAR
description: Main bag up to 152 slots (runes and ammo tabs optional), pickups go to the bag first, the right tool comes out when you hit a rock, tree or farm plot, and one key for tools. Existing characters: empty the runes, ammo and quest tabs into a chest before changing the size.

settings.label: Main bag slots
settings.tooltip: Slots in the main bag (vanilla 24). Before raising it on an existing character, move everything from the Runes, Ammo and Quest tabs into a chest. Never lower it on a character you play.

settings.label: Runes and ammo slots
settings.tooltip: Slots in the Runes and Ammo tabs (vanilla 24). The quest tab stays at its vanilla 72. Same rule: empty the Runes, Ammo and Quest tabs into a chest before raising it, never lower it.

settings.label: Hide inventory scroll bar
settings.tooltip: Hides the inventory scroll bar that can stay visible after the inventory is closed.

settings.label: Bag first
settings.tooltip: Picked-up items go into your bag instead of filling empty hotbar slots. Stacks already on the hotbar still grow. In co-op the host's setting decides.

settings.label: Auto tool on hit
settings.tooltip: Hit a rock, tree or farm plot with the wrong item and the right tool comes out of your bag. Never from a bow, crossbow, staff, wand, seeds or potions.

settings.label: Also from melee weapons
settings.tooltip: Also swap away from a sword, dagger, mace and other melee weapons, but only for a rock or tree right in front of you, so fights are not disturbed.

settings.label: Tool key
settings.tooltip: Face a rock, tree, farm plot or fishing spot and press it: the best tool for it comes out of your bag. Pick None to turn it off.

settings.label: Rock and tree reach
settings.tooltip: How close a rock or tree must be, in front of you.

settings.label: Compost bucket for watered plots
settings.tooltip: On a watered farm plot the key takes out the compost bucket. Off: a watered plot gets no tool.
